scope: Descriptive historical comparison of complete retained matrices; transport implementation/geometry differ; no isolated-cause or statistical-significance claim

definitions.rate: goodput_mbps requires full CRC/hash/order integrity; full-integrity timing-invalid observations are diagnostic only; no partial-prefix substitution
definitions.latency: median of per-trial surviving-response percentiles; N counts trials with a finite metric, not pooled RTT samples
definitions.matched: each metric uses exactly the same finite/eligible seed intersection on both sides; PR-minus-baseline delta is descriptive
definitions.probes: all scheduled probes from warmup start through measurement stop; missing/artifact-invalid counters remain unknown and prevent complete totals; measurement response count accompanies survivor tails
definitions.unknown: missing/unavailable flags and counters stay null with known/unknown counts; driver state is unavailable in the original adapter
definitions.qualification: qualified COMPLETE requires stream integrity, timing, health and independently reconciled complete probe service; missing or incomplete probe counters withhold qualified metrics; a failed50/70% trial never yields qualified goodput

baseline.basis: recognized frozen endpoint source constructs P*64

pr.basis: recognized frozen endpoint source constructs P*64

declared_adapter.stats_semantics: legacy separate send/receive state; driver fault diagnostic unavailable
